paragraphs: (Chanan son of Gedaliah, [Jeremiah 35:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jeremiah.35.4).) Abba bar Chanan, [Avodah Zarah 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.60b.10).
Rabbi Chelbo bar Chanan, [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.7.1.5).
Rabbi Yudan bar Chanan, Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:6. Abba Yose bar Chanan (Chana), Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:5.
Rav Papa son of Rav Chanan, [Bava Batra 153a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.153a.10).[^1]

notes.text: Jeremiah gives Yigdalyahu in the consulted Hebrew. In the linked Jerusalem Talmud, the title before Chanan is bracketed as [Rav], while [Heilprin’s Chelbo entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1316&lang=en) gives bar Chanan. [His Rav Papa entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2986&lang=en) identifies the scribe in Bava Batra. The forms cited for Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin and Bava Kamma remain Hyman’s reports.
